metadata.title: ScrapTrace
metadata.description: Safe e-waste recovery, from first record to reviewed outcome.

public.title: Track e-waste with a clear chain of evidence
public.description: ScrapTrace connects safe identification, approved guidance and recovery records without overstating what a photo can prove.

pages.collectorDescription: Start a record, revisit saved work or find a suitable receiving location.
pages.captureDescription: Camera capture and uploads will be implemented in the collector journey milestone.
pages.recordsDescription: Record lists and journey details will be implemented in a later milestone.
pages.locationsDescription: Programme-verified receiving locations near this collector node.
pages.profileDescription: Account, language and local-data controls will be added with authentication.
pages.recyclerDescription: QR intake, measured weight and evidence workflows are intentionally deferred.
pages.reviewDescription: The review queue will preserve flags as indicators requiring human judgement.
pages.managementDescription: Reporting will include only role-authorised, status-separated totals.
pages.safetyDescription: Approved-card governance will be built against the safety service contract.
pages.mlDescription: Corrections will remain reviewed candidates and will never retrain a model automatically.

pages.onboardingDescription: Language and privacy choices will be added in the collector journey milestone.

preview.title: Development preview only
preview.description: Choosing a role opens its workspace so the layout can be reviewed. It does not sign you in, and backend authorization is always required.
preview.unavailableDescription: Authentication will be added in a later milestone.

offline.banner: Offline Mode — Data saved locally on device

security.accessDeniedDescription: You do not have the required role or permission to view this page.
security.accessDeniedNotice: This attempt may be logged. No record details are shown here.
security.sessionExpiredDescription: For security, sessions end after a period of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.
security.sessionExpiredNotice: Sign in again to continue. Nothing is shown until you are authenticated.

screens.deferred: This action becomes available in a later milestone.
screens.sampleData: Illustrative sample data from the approved design. These are not live records.

onboarding.title: ScrapTrace
onboarding.subtitle: Public E-Waste Recovery & Traceability Infrastructure. Choose language to proceed.
onboarding.note: Public recovery networks enforce offline reliability. Local settings cached automatically on confirmation.

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Governance
privacy.subtitle: Public service protocols protect your personal details while verifying ecological outcomes.
privacy.requiredText: Capture photo evidence of recovery state (materials check), record GPS coordinates (trusted audit loop), and preserve device records.
privacy.optionalText: Allow image-based classification models to train on anonymous physical wear & tear profiles to improve automated classification.
privacy.noteText: Camera access requested only when Capture is initiated. Location verification requested only for Nearby and Verified GPS records.

collectorHome.registerText: Capture items securely. (Operational camera and location verification requested upon start.)
collectorHome.privacy: Privacy reminder: ScrapTrace registers material volume only. Avoid capturing faces or PII.

records.safetyText: Always use non-conductive gloves when moving cracked battery packs. Keep sealed.

capture.photographHint: Show the whole item and any damage. Avoid faces, documents and number plates.
capture.photographRequired: A photograph is required before a record can be created.
capture.suggestionNote: A demonstration classifier, not a trained model. You decide the category; your choice is what is stored.
capture.noSuggestionText: The classifier was not confident enough. Choose the category yourself.
capture.correctionHint: Recorded with the correction so the model can be reviewed later.
capture.correctionReasonRequired: Say why you changed the suggested category.
capture.weightHint: Required for a mixed batch. Optional otherwise.
capture.weightRequiredForBatch: A mixed batch needs an approximate weight.
capture.areaHint: A neighbourhood or district. Never a street address.
capture.locationDenied: Location permission was refused. The record keeps the coarse area only.
capture.locationUnavailable: This device cannot provide a location.
capture.destinationHint: Only locations that accept this category are listed.
capture.offlineNote: You are offline. The record is saved here and queued for synchronization.
capture.recordedText: Reference {reference}. Show its transfer code at handoff.
capture.saveFailed: The record could not be saved on this device.
capture.incompleteTitle: This record is not complete yet

account.clearHint: Permanently removes locally stored recovery records and unsynced drafts from this physical storage drive.
account.trainingSaved: Your choice was saved on this device.
account.trainingHint: You can change this at any time. Exports exclude images from collectors who decline.

clearCache.warningText: You are about to delete {records} cached offline recovery records and {drafts} unfinished draft.
clearCache.warningStrong: Server records that have already synchronized will remain intact.
clearCache.clearedText: Records, queued work and photographs were removed from this device. Anything the programme already accepted is unaffected.

recyclerHome.verifyText: Scan a local collector's QR voucher or enter identification code manually to confirm intake receipt.
recyclerHome.batchText: Reported copper volume matches indicative estimates, waiting for manual confirmation.

recyclerIntake.scanText: Present this code to hand over materials or scan a collector's local transfer record.

manager.estimatesText: Estimated weight allocations based on statistical model reference guides. No regulatory or final processing guarantees implied.
manager.verifiedText: Physical measured weights confirmed by disassembly centers and registered directly into the secure ledger of processing outcomes.

safety.mercuryText: Regulatory advisory targeting fluorescent mercury bulb breakage during sorting activities. Ensure immediate non-spark ventilation is active.
safety.leadText: Safe physical handling guidelines of cathode ray tube funnels containing heavy metals. Use protective aprons and thick puncture-resistant gloves.

ml.verifyGps: Verify Image Resolution matches GPS Coordinates

processing.heading: Batches in processing ({count})
processing.evidenceText: A processing outcome is accepted only with a measured weight and a photograph of the processed material. Both are captured in the processing milestone.

recyclerAccount.intakeAlertsHint: Notify this device when a collector publishes a batch for handoff.

assigned.judgementText: An assignment never carries a recommended outcome. Every decision is recorded as the reviewer's own judgement.

decisions.appendOnlyText: A recorded decision is never edited or removed. A changed outcome is added as a new decision that references the original.

history.heading: Recent record events
history.integrityTitle: History is derived, never typed in
history.integrityText: Events come from recorded state transitions. Nothing on this screen can be edited by hand.

ledger.areaText: The ledger reports an approximate area. A collector's precise coordinates are never published here.

recoveryLocations.reviewText: A location keeps its verified status only while its review is current. Expired entries stop receiving routed records.

prices.indicativeText: Reference prices support programme planning only. They are never a payment guarantee and are never shown to collectors as an offer.

reports.heading: Available reports
reports.recoverySummaryText: Record counts by state and recorded weight for the selected range and area.
reports.verifiedOutcomesText: Measured weights from approved and completed records only, kept apart from indicative estimates.
reports.handoffText: Time between publishing a batch for handoff and a facility confirming receipt.
reports.separationText: Every report keeps indicative estimates apart from verified outcomes, and includes only records the requesting role is authorised to see.

settings.reviewAlerts: Alert reviewers when a record is flagged
settings.scopeText: A change here applies to every workspace. Saving arrives with the configuration service.

translations.groundingText: A translated card carries the same approved source references as the original, and is never published without review.

approvals.heading: Awaiting approval ({count})
approvals.separationTitle: Author and approver are different people
approvals.separationText: The administrator who drafted a card cannot approve it. Approval is recorded with the approver's identity and date.
approvals.emptyDescription: Submitted safety cards appear here for a second administrator to review.

published.reviewText: A card stops being offered as approved guidance after its review date. Collectors then receive the safe fallback message instead.

labels.governanceTitle: Approved labels never retrain a model automatically
labels.governanceText: Labels are a reviewed dataset. Retraining is a separate, deliberate step with its own approval.

model.name: Model
model.precisionNote: Measured on the held-out evaluation set. Precision is not a promise about any single image.
model.scopeText: A prediction is never a record's category. A person confirms or corrects every classification before it is stored.

exports.heading: Recent exports
exports.consentText: Images from collectors who declined optional training reuse are excluded, and no personal details leave the programme.

register.organisationRequired: Enter an organisation or collection node.
register.codeRequired: Enter the invitation code from the programme.
register.recorded: Nothing was submitted. Account creation arrives with authentication in a later milestone.
register.noteTitle: Requests are reviewed by the programme
register.noteText: An account is issued only after the programme confirms the organisation and the role it may hold.

outbox.heading: Waiting to synchronize ({count})
outbox.onlineText: This work is saved on the device and has not reached the programme yet.
outbox.offlineText: The device is offline. This work stays here until a connection is available.

safetyGuidance.title: Approved safety guidance
safetyGuidance.fallbackTitle: No approved guidance for this category
safetyGuidance.provenance: Approved card version {version}, approved {approved}, next review {review}.

record.noHistory: No events have been recorded for this record yet.
record.transferText: Show this to the receiving facility. It carries only an opaque token: no name, location or value.
record.codeCopyFailed: The code could not be copied. Read it out instead.
